content_sections.heading: TISS Medical Officer (Part Time) Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) for filling part-time medical officer positions at their Mumbai health centre.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Medical Officer (Part Time) under the healthcare field on a contractual basis in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Medical Officer (Part Time) post under advertisement number ADVT/TISS/MO/SEP/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for TISS Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and be registered with the NMC or State Medical Council along with 1 year of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 65 years of age as of 30th September, 2026 to be eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between Rs. 50,000 and Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply online for TISS Medical Officer 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application form is 05-10-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General candidates?
faq.answer: General category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-, whereas fees for women candidates are completely waived.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for TISS Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises short-listing of applications followed by a personal interaction round for the provisionally shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for the TISS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website www.tiss.ac.in and filling out the application form using a valid Gmail ID.
